name: pdf-from-html
description: Generate PDF documents from HTML templates using weasyprint. Supports CSS styling, embedded images, custom fonts, and dynamic content via Jinja2.
system_deps_note: Requires system libs pre-installed in sandbox image: libpango1.0-0, libpangocairo-1.0-0, libcairo2, libgdk-pixbuf-2.0-0, libffi-dev, shared-mime-info, fonts-wqy-zenhei (see T15 in DECISIONS.md)
